description: This bar chart illustrates the accuracy of four different language models—Qwen2.5-7b-1M, Internlm3-8b, ProLong-8b, and Qwen2.5-7b—on a multi-retrieval task, with performance measured across five distinct attributes: city, hobby, university, major, and birthdate. The horizontal axis lists the model names in left-to-right order, while the vertical axis represents accuracy on a linear scale ranging from 0 to 100, with tick marks at intervals of 20. Each model is represented by a group of five vertically stacked bars, each corresponding to one attribute and color-coded according to the legend: city (teal), hobby (orange), university (blue), major (pink), and birthdate (light green). For the Qwen2.5-7b-1M model, the bars show accuracies of approximately 90 for city, 90 for hobby, 90 for university, 90 for major, and 90 for birthdate. For Internlm3-8b, the values are approximately 70 for city, 75 for hobby, 55 for university, 65 for major, and 90 for birthdate. For ProLong-8b, the values are approximately 70 for city, 80 for hobby, 60 for university, 30 for major, and 90 for birthdate. For Qwen2.5-7b, the values are approximately 2 for city, 5 for hobby, 5 for university, 5 for major, and 15 for birthdate. The bars are not sorted and are visually presented as grouped sets for each model, with no additional emphasis or annotation beyond the color-coded legend.
